baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative سَبِّحِ governs the construct phrase اسم ربك, while الأعلى qualifies the Lord.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two live images in س ب ح combine enacted worship with declaring free from defect. The name is the raised designation on which that clearing operates, lordship supplies the relation of authority, and الأعلى assigns qualitative rank. The line therefore commands an act that is at once vocal, ritual, and corrective.

activation_trace.role: Worship through praise and prayer supplies the enacted mode: the imperative is performed rather than merely described.
Purifying and declaring free supplies the negative operation: every unworthy attribution is pushed away.
Name as raised designation makes اسم the public and repeatable carrier of the clearing act.
Lordship, ownership, and authority specify the relational claim in ربك.
Noble high rank gives الأعلى qualitative precedence rather than only vertical location.

changed_reading.before: Say a generic formula stating that God is high.
changed_reading.after: Enact praise and prayer that clear your Lord's designated name of every unworthy association and accord it incomparable rank.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence سَبِّحِ ... رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى joins a motion-capable imperative to lordship and rising.
baseline_models.mechanism: Coursing in س ب ح, rising in both اسم and الأعلى, and the repair-and-growth branches of رب turn verticality into a process. The Lord is not only one who occupies highest rank, but one whose care brings beings toward completion; glorification aligns speech and life with that upward nurture.

activation_trace.role: Swimming or coursing makes the imperative kinetically sustained rather than a static utterance.
Rising high lets the designation itself participate in an upward trajectory.
Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship a stagewise formative relation.
The non-dominant mapped branch of nurture and growing up reinforces development without replacing the surface root.
Rising and being high supplies both the source and the direction of the developmental motion.

changed_reading.before: Praise a static sovereign located above.
changed_reading.after: Let glorification course toward the Lord whose formative care repairs, grows, and raises beings toward completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object اسم carries both its dominant designation branch and packet-supplied non-dominant marking branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: The name can function not only as a spoken label but as an identifying sign from which a condition is discerned. Coupled with the clearing force of سَبِّحِ, the command asks the reader to keep the sign of lordship distinguishable from counterfeit marks of authority.

activation_trace.role: Declaring free supplies the act of removing misleading associations from the sign.
Raised designation preserves the ordinary naming anchor.
A visible identifying mark turns the name into a sign that can be recognized.
A sign read by discerning observation makes correct recognition, not mere visibility, part of glorification.
Repair and nurture provide the condition by which true lordship can be diagnosed.

changed_reading.before: Treat the name as a sound-label that is simply pronounced.
changed_reading.after: Purify and read the identifying sign of nurturing lordship so that it remains distinct from false marks of mastery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first two context pairs move from measured origination to completed form, then from deliberate apportioning to gentle direction. They revise highest lordship from remote superiority into authority visible as calibrated formation and guidance, strengthening the nurturing ascent baseline while excluding capricious domination.

activation_trace.role: Clearing now removes the image of arbitrary or merely forceful superiority.
Stagewise repair and completion provide the focus-side model that the context specifies.
Mastery remains live, but is rendered as competent command of a formative process.
Estimating and measuring a thing supplies design before finished form.
Straightness and intrinsic completion supply the achieved configuration.
Planning through estimation and consideration makes apportioning purposive.
Gentle indication toward road and truth turns measured capacity into directed movement.

structural_cues: The adjacent pairs خلق فسوى and قدر فهدى each move from an initiating act to an ordered outcome.
Both pairs immediately follow the command and the title ربك الأعلى.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measurement, completion, planning, and gentle guidance; I infer that their sequence explicates how lordship is high. A live alternative is that they are independent proofs of power rather than a definition of lordship.

changed_reading.before: The Highest Lord is chiefly a remote owner above creation.
changed_reading.after: Glorify the Highest Lord whose mastery appears as measured origination, completion, apportioning, and gentle guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: A packet-supplied branch makes اسم a first rain that marks earth with growth, while a رب branch supplies layered rain-cloud. The ordered emergence of pasture and its transformation into dark stubble lets the Lord's name be read as an ecological signature across both flourishing and decay, not only as a vocal token.

activation_trace.role: Clearing prevents the material trace from being mistaken for an independent deity; it remains a sign of the Lord.
First rain marking earth with vegetation supplies the central image of a name written as growth.
Layered cloud links lordship materially to persistent rain and plant nurture.
Bringing a thing out of concealment makes vegetation the visible emergence of the mark.
Pasture supplies the living and usable phase of the ecological inscription.
Causing a thing to become another state supplies the transition rather than a separate creation.
Pasture becoming brittle refuse carries the same marked matter into decay.
Blackness or red tending to black gives the cycle its dark terminal visibility.

structural_cues: The object pasture persists through the sequence: it is brought out, then made dark stubble.
The focus name precedes a context in which rain-associated growth becomes visibly marked and then transformed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain-as-mark, cloud, emergence, pasture, transformation, refuse, and darkening; I supply the arrow that treats the full cycle as an earthly inscription of the name. The live alternative is a botanical proof of power with no semiotic claim.

changed_reading.before: Glorification concerns a name spoken apart from material processes.
changed_reading.after: Clear and recognize the Highest Lord's name as a rain-mark legible through the whole material cycle of emergence, nourishment, darkening, and decay.

context_deltas.mechanism: The imperative expands into an operational loop: material is gathered into recitation, protected against loss, held across audible and hidden registers, made easy, and released as reminder. This strengthens the liturgical baseline by making glorification a received and transmissible practice rather than a private instant.

activation_trace.role: Praise, prayer, and remembrance supply the focus-side practice that the context operationalizes.
The designation is the stable verbal carrier through successive acts of reception and reminder.
Gathering and assembling supply the formation of recitable material.
Reading, reciting, and causing to recite supply oral reception and transmission.
Loss of remembrance names the failure that the promise suspends.
Announcement and raised voice supply the outwardly audible register.
Concealment supplies the inward register that remains within divine knowledge.
Opening and ease after difficulty make continued transmission practicable.
Reminder as that which causes remembering completes the loop in another hearer.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from divine causing-to-recite through non-forgetting and ease to the renewed imperative فذكر.
The manifest-hidden pair prevents the practice from being reduced to audible volume alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, recitation, forgetting, outward voicing, concealment, ease, and reminder; I infer a transmission loop that unfolds the opening imperative. Alternatively, these may be separate assurances and instructions whose only connection is topical.

changed_reading.before: Glorify once in a private utterance.
changed_reading.after: Receive, preserve, voice, inwardly retain, and transmit the Lord's designation as a continuing cycle of glorification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places avoidance of reminder on a path toward fire-contact, then places self-purification and naming on a path toward prayer. The split ص ل ي and ص ل و inventories keep both heat-contact and worship active. Against that fork, the opening سَبِّحِ is an orientation of approach: enacted praise moves toward prayer rather than destructive exposure.

activation_trace.role: Worship through praise and prayer places the opening imperative on the devotional side of the later fork.
Putting away and withdrawing supplies the negative orientation away from reminder.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies one terminal mode of contact.
Purity and rectitude supply the contrary preparation for devotional contact.
Specified worship supplies the other terminal mode of contact: prayer.

structural_cues: Avoidance in 87:11 leads into يصلى النار, while purification and naming in 87:14-15 lead into فصلى.
The two surface roots map into overlapping branch inventories that contain both fire-contact and prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the opposed sequences and overlapping ص ل ي/ص ل و branches; I infer a rhetorical fork between two modes of contact. The live alternative is ordinary lexical contrast with no intentional root-play.

changed_reading.before: Tasbih is a praise act with no directional stakes.
changed_reading.after: Tasbih begins a chosen approach: clearing and naming orient the person toward prayer and mercy rather than toward consuming heat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later fire can itself be الكبرى, maximally great in magnitude. That comparison prevents الأعلى from collapsing into sheer size, force, or domination. The clearing force of سَبِّحِ instead favors noble rank and rightful mastery while actively excluding haughty superiority.

activation_trace.role: Declaring free performs the semantic correction between worthy highness and destructive bigness.
Nobility and high rank supply a qualitative reading of الأعلى.
Haughty domination supplies the nearby but rejected counterfeit of highness.
Encountering heat makes the later superlative concretely destructive.
Kindled fire supplies the object whose greatness cannot define divine highness.
Magnitude as the opposite of smallness gives الكبرى a quantitative axis for contrast.

structural_cues: The surah applies two different superlative forms to the Lord and to the fire.
The command to clear precedes both, making semantic discrimination part of the opening act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies qualitative and blameworthy branches for علو plus magnitude and fire branches for the later الكبرى; I infer contrast between kinds of greatness. The alternative is that both adjectives simply intensify their separate nouns.

changed_reading.before: Most High means the greatest concentration of size and coercive power.
changed_reading.after: Clear the Lord's highness of the destructive magnitude and haughty domination that even a great fire can display; retain noble and rightful mastery.

context_deltas.mechanism: Verses 14-15 unpack the opening command into a sequence: purification, successful endurance, mention of the Lord's name, and prayer. The lexical return of اسم ربه confirms the object, while فصلى realizes the worship branch already latent in سَبِّحِ.

activation_trace.role: Praise and prayer are the compressed ritual action later unfolded.
Purification and declaring free anticipate the later self-purification.
Winning and remaining supply the durable outcome of the ritual sequence.
Purity and rectitude externalize the clearing operation in the worshipper.
Mention flowing on the tongue realizes the vocal component.
The repeated designation directly returns to the focus object اسم.
Repeated lordship preserves the relational frame of nurture and completion.
Specified worship supplies the enacted culmination in prayer.

structural_cues: اسم ربه in 87:15 nearly repeats the focus construct اسم ربك with a changed pronoun.
Purification precedes naming, and the fa-linked prayer follows it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical echo and branches of purification, tongue-mention, naming, lordship, and prayer; I infer that 87:14-15 decompresses the opening imperative. The alternative is a later example of piety rather than an internal gloss.

changed_reading.before: The opening imperative is an isolated formula.
changed_reading.after: The imperative compresses a lived sequence: become clear, keep the Lord's designation present on the tongue, and embody that remembrance in prayer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies a chain of media for recognition: a distinguishing mark, a documentary reminder, a surviving trace, and a written sheet. These images strengthen the readable-mark baseline by letting اسم persist across perception, memory, history, and inscription.

activation_trace.role: The visible identifying mark is the focus-side sign that travels through different media.
Discerning by a sign requires interpretation at each stage, not mere repetition.
A distinguishing trace that guides the observer supplies perceptual recognition.
A document securing a right turns remembrance into attestable record.
A remaining sign of what has passed supplies historical persistence.
The written sheet supplies an archival surface on which the designation can endure.

structural_cues: Knowing manifest and hidden material is followed later by remembrance, preference, and appeal to written sheets.
The repeated اسم in 87:15 sits between mnemonic and archival portions of the context.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mark, indicative trace, right-document, surviving effect, and written sheet; I connect them as a carrier chain for the name. A live alternative is that these are independent branch images with no shared semiotic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The name exists only during pronunciation.
changed_reading.after: Keep the Lord's identifying sign clear as it moves from observation to remembrance, surviving trace, and written record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit choice of lower-near life over the later, better, and more enduring one converts vertical language into an ethics of preference. The call-to-come-up branch of الأعلى becomes a summons addressed through the imperative: glorification reorders what the addressee chooses.

activation_trace.role: Coursing supplies movement away from one orientation and toward another.
The invitation to come up lets الأعلى function as a summons without ceasing to qualify the Lord.
Choosing one thing over another supplies the decision point.
The lower and nearer supplies the immediately attractive downward pole.
Laterness after the first supplies temporal distance from the near option.
Inclination toward beneficial good supplies the evaluative direction of ascent.
Continuance and remaining supply the durable horizon of the choice.

structural_cues: The lower-near الدنيا is directly opposed to the later آخِرة.
خير and أبقى evaluate the later pole as both better and more durable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preference, lower-nearness, laterness, benefit, endurance, and a focus branch of calling upward; I infer that glorification trains desire to ascend. The alternative is a moral contrast that does not alter the semantics of the opening title.

changed_reading.before: Most High reports only the Lord's status.
changed_reading.after: Glorifying the Most High is also accepting a summons to lift preference from the immediately lower toward what is later, better, and enduring.

context_deltas.mechanism: A focus branch of علو includes what is carried above and a title at the top of writing. When the context closes with written sheets and firstness, that material image activates a superscription reading: the Lord's designation is kept uppermost across inherited records. This is a layout metaphor, not a grammatical reassignment of الأعلى away from رب.

activation_trace.role: Clearing supplies editorial and theological purification of the designation.
Name as raised designation supplies the textually repeatable heading.
What is placed above, including a title at the top of writing, supplies the superscription image.
Written sheets provide the physical surface on which an upper designation can recur.
Gathering sheets into a written collection extends the heading across records.
Beginning and precedence locate the inscription in earlier transmission.

structural_cues: The final two verses repeat الصحف and identify them as الأولى.
The opening contains both اسم and a branch-capable image of what stands at the top of writing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies designation, an upper title, written sheets, collection, and precedence; I infer a superscription metaphor across inherited texts. The live alternative, and syntactically primary reading, is that الأعلى modifies رب while the sheets merely attest the teaching.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's name is raised only in present speech.
changed_reading.after: Keep the Highest Lord's designation uppermost as a purified heading carried through the earliest written records.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the nominal bead-counting branch under a verbal imperative and imports no beads into the syntax. It remains anchored by the supplied س ب ح branch and by context branches of measured limit and gathering. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy for calibrated repetition, not a claim that the ayah denotes prayer beads.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سَبِّحِ can retain a faint material resonance from the counting-beads branch while remaining an imperative of glorification.

activation_trace.role: Beads used to count tasbih supply repeatable units of practice.
Estimating and measuring creation supply a cosmological analogue for calibrated units.
An amount reaching its proper limit supplies bounded repetition rather than indefinite accumulation.
Gathering turns separate recited units into a coherent practice.

changed_reading.before: Praise is an unstructured spontaneous utterance.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the reading, glorification can be imagined as measured, gathered repetition that mirrors a creation brought to proper measure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is odd because it activates the room-for-going-about and livelihood branch of س ب ح rather than its direct devotional branch. It remains focus-anchored and gains contextual support from pasture, easy motion, and life as benefit. Downstream prose should present it as an embodied extension of tasbih into daily movement, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The imperative سَبِّحِ can carry the packet's image of having room to move through livelihood.

activation_trace.role: Room for going about and livelihood relocates glorification into ordinary movement.
Nurture and administration make daily provision part of the lordship relation.
Pasture supplies a concrete economy of sustenance and movement.
Lightness and tractability in motion supply an eased way of going about.
Life as benefit and good keeps livelihood from being treated as spiritually empty.

changed_reading.before: Glorification belongs to a bounded ritual interval outside livelihood.
changed_reading.after: Carry the Highest Lord's name through the room of daily movement and provision, letting livelihood itself course as praise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most form-distant reading because it uses the third-ranked س م م mapping for اسم. It remains valid as an exploratory activation because the packet explicitly supplies the narrow-opening branch, while coursing, recitation, concealment-removal, and announcement form a coherent passage mechanism. Downstream prose must label it a mapping resonance, not equate اسم lexically with an aperture.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: اسم at word 2 is the sole aperture anchor, reinforced by the governing motion-capable سَبِّحِ.

activation_trace.role: A narrow opening of entry supplies the aperture through which meaning passes.
Coursing supplies movement through the opening rather than a static label.
Reciting and causing to recite provide the verbal material passing through.
Removing concealment supplies emergence from the hidden side of the aperture.
Announcement and raised voice supply the manifest side of the passage.

changed_reading.before: The name is a closed verbal token.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the name is a narrow verbal aperture through which hidden knowledge courses into manifest recitation.

strongest_changes: The creation pairs recast lordship as measured, stagewise formation and gentle guidance rather than remote status.
The pasture-to-dark-stubble cycle activates the name as a rain-mark or ecological signature legible through both flourishing and decay.
Recitation, non-forgetting, manifest and hidden knowledge, ease, and reminder expand the imperative into a preserved transmission loop.
The echo in 87:14-15 decompresses سَبِّحِ into purification, naming, and prayer, while the ص ل ي and ص ل و mappings keep a fire/prayer fork live.
The الدنيا and الآخرة contrast turns الأعلى into a summons to reorder preference toward what is better and lasting.
The written sheets activate a contained superscription reading in which the Lord's designation remains uppermost in transmission.
summary.what_was_special: The split mappings let اسم coexist as designation, visible mark, rain-trace, and even a narrow aperture, while رب joined authority to repair and growth. Material, mnemonic, ethical, ritual, and textual readings therefore remain live without being merged into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Syntax keeps الأعلى as a qualifier of رب; the superscription reading is a layout metaphor, not a reassignment of grammatical attachment.
The non-dominant mappings are packet-supplied but form-distant, so the mark, rain-trace, and aperture activations require explicit exploratory qualification.
Several causal arrows are inferred from sequence; the context could instead enumerate independent signs and instructions.
The fire/prayer fork may be rhetorical juxtaposition rather than deliberate play across the overlapping ص ل ي and ص ل و inventories.
